description: Migrate existing-resource mutation tools and Channels boundaries to verified Record inputs; keep create operations unchanged.

comments.text: Implemented Record-based data_source_update_file flow: UpdateDocument now accepts Record input, Channels API rejects legacy provider params, DataSourceBridge verifies provenance and derives provider/config/file identity from signed claims, BO update dispatch sends Record+params, docs/tests updated. Validation: mix format, focused data-source/channel suites, mix q.

Follow-up fix after real update payload: update_document now supports explicit nested changes, copied current Record path is scrubbed before provider dispatch, and Storage resolves relative move destinations against the source volume instead of returning :volume_required.
